api_endpoints_verified.notes: Returns engine config (engineType, controls, voices, stylePresets) based on active provider
Returns Gemini voices when Gemini active, ElevenLabs voices when ElevenLabs active

critical_code_review_comments: Admin voice settings API correctly implemented at GET/POST /api/admin-9821/voice-settings
Provider names (ElevenLabs, Gemini) correctly hidden from creators - only 'default' and 'alternate' exposed
Creator TTS settings API (/api/tts/settings) correctly returns different controls based on active provider
Creator voices API (/api/voices) correctly returns Gemini voices when Gemini active
VoiceGenerator.js correctly uses engineSettings.engineType === 'alternate' to show/hide controls
AdminDashboard.js correctly shows generic 'Default Voice Engine'/'Alternate Voice Engine' in dropdown
Gemini-specific controls (Style Preset, Custom Instructions) correctly hidden when ElevenLabs active
ElevenLabs-specific controls (Stability, Similarity, Style, Speed sliders, Speaker Boost, Dialogue tab) correctly hidden when Gemini active
Provider switch takes effect instantly without redeploy - verified via full cycle test

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All UI elements verified for both providers)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing Voice Test Story with character 'Alice'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-provider voice generation system fully tested. Admin can switch providers at /api/admin-9821/voice-settings (accepts 'elevenlabs' or 'gemini'). Creator UI dynamically adapts based on active provider: ElevenLabs shows character select, stability modes, sliders, speaker boost, dialogue tab; Gemini shows voice dropdown, style preset, custom instructions. Provider names are never exposed to creators - only generic 'default'/'alternate' terms used. Default state is ElevenLabs.
